title: How Much a Trading Coach Costs
seoTitle: How Much Does a Trading Coach Cost in 2026?
seoDescription: Real 2026 pricing for trading coaches: session rates, group programs, and one-on-one mentorship. What each tier includes and when the spend is justified.
headline: How Much a Trading Coach Costs in 2026, and What You Should Get for It
subheadline: Pricing in this industry is opaque on purpose. Here is what each tier actually costs, what belongs in each one, and how to tell when you are paying mentorship prices for course content.
intro: A trading coach costs roughly $100 to $250 for a single session, $200 to $600 a month for group coaching, and $150 to $400 a week for ongoing one-on-one mentorship. Multi-month intensive programs run $3,000 to $8,000. The number matters less than what is inside it: the thing you are paying for is having someone review your actual trades and correct your specific mistakes, and plenty of programs at the top of that range never do it.

keyPoints.title: Single Sessions: $100 to $250
keyPoints.text: Useful for a specific problem: a strategy review, a post-mortem on a failed challenge, or a second opinion on your risk model. Not useful for learning to trade, because one session cannot build a habit. Treat this tier as consulting rather than education.

keyPoints.title: Group Coaching: $200 to $600 a Month
keyPoints.text: Live calls, a shared curriculum, and a community. Good value if you are self-directed and mainly need structure and accountability. The limit is attention: in a room of thirty, your specific mistakes get a few minutes at best. Fine early on, thin once your errors get subtle.

keyPoints.title: One-on-One: $150 to $400 a Week
keyPoints.text: Sessions built around your charts, your journal, and your errors. This is where the correction loop actually runs. R2F prices this at $150 a week for one session or $250 a week for two. Expect to commit a quarter for it to be worth anything, because the value compounds through repetition.

keyPoints.title: Multi-Month Intensives: $3,000 to $8,000
keyPoints.text: A defined program with a start and end, usually two sessions a week plus between-session review. R2F's is $5,000 for four months. The advantage over weekly billing is that both sides commit to a full arc instead of drifting. The risk is paying a large sum upfront, so ask what happens if it is not working by month two.

keyPoints.title: When the Spend Is Not Justified
keyPoints.text: If you have not put in real screen time yet, coaching is premature and free material plus a demo account will get you further. If you cannot cover the fee without touching trading capital, wait. Coaching accelerates a process that is already underway. It does not create one from nothing, and paying for it with money you need is the wrong trade.

faqs.q: How much does a trading coach cost per hour?
faqs.a: Individual sessions typically run $100 to $250 an hour. Ongoing mentorship is usually priced weekly or as a program rather than hourly, because the value comes from repeated review over months rather than from any single hour.

faqs.q: Why do trading coaches charge so differently?
faqs.a: Because the label covers very different products. Some sell recorded course content with a chat group. Others review your live trades weekly. Both call it coaching. Ask specifically how often your own charts get reviewed, and by whom, and the price differences start making sense.

No. Price tracks positioning and marketing spend at least as much as quality. What predicts value is whether the coach trades live, shows real results including bad months, and works on your specific errors. A $250 a week coach who does all three beats a $10,000 program that does none.

faqs.q: Can I negotiate trading coaching prices?
faqs.a: Sometimes, particularly on longer commitments. A more useful ask is a shorter trial: one or two paid sessions before committing to a full program. A coach confident in the work will usually agree to that.

Lite is $150 a week for one session, Pro is $250 a week for two sessions, and the Full Mentorship is $5,000 for four months with two sessions a week. Discovery calls are free and there is no obligation attached to them.
